A field notebook for the pipe sizing arithmetic you already do on paper, plus the citation that says where each reading came from.
What this app does and does not do

It sums the loads and developed lengths you type, converts imperial and metric units in both directions, and compares the capacity you confirmed against the load you need. It ships no code tables, asserts no result when an input, citation, range or consistency check is missing, and does not certify compliance.
Why a result can be refused

A number produced for the wrong code edition, unit or method is worse than no number. When a reading is missing, unparseable, out of range, or inconsistent with the selected method, the app names what to correct instead of calculating.

Your cases are stored on this device and restored when you reopen the app. They are never uploaded. Free-tier builds show interstitial and rewarded ads through Google AdMob; Pro removes them. On the free tier the advertising ID may be used for ad delivery and measurement, gated by the ad choices above.
Pro is a one-time purchase handled by Google Play; it is not a subscription and nothing renews. Restoring a purchase on a new device uses the same Google account.
